concept.hr: AS daje TGT, TGS kartu za uslugu, AP otvara mapu; razlika satova to ruši
concept.en: AS gives a TGT, TGS a service ticket, AP opens the share; clock skew breaks it

summary.hr: Korak po korak: ana otvara \\fs01\projects. Karte su zaključane ključem koji ana nema; sat PC07 koji odstupa više od 5 minuta ruši prijavu.
summary.en: Step by step: ana opens \\fs01\projects. Tickets are locked with keys ana does not hold; a PC07 clock more than 5 minutes off breaks the logon.
